question: I want to know the preferences of customers who purchased the Google Navy Speckled Tee in December 2020. What other product was purchased with the highest total quantity alongside this item?
sql:
WITH navy_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(items) i
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' 
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND LOWER(i.item_name) = 'google navy speckled tee'
)
SELECT i.item_name, SUM(i.quantity) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e, UNNEST(items) i
WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase' 
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND e.ecommerce.transaction_id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM navy_transactions)
  AND LOWER(i.item_name) != 'google navy speckled tee'
GROUP BY i.item_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
